runs.summary: The week was dominated by large parallel-agent builds (SLAMWICH’s scout/cook/judge design-portfolio pipeline and d3-lwc’s wave-4 chart conversions) alongside a deep pass on WRINKLEMAXX’s knowledge architecture (context-window discipline, qmd vs LightRAG, a PARA-method critique) and a Claude Code skill-ecosystem migration to mattpocock/skills.

The operator's week centered on hardening headless-agent automation (nightly/weekly reports, replacing a risky auto-commit job), plumbing personal knowledge-base and remote-access infrastructure, vetting eval-harness datasets, and orchestrating fleets of parallel research agents to mine web design references into a reusable skill.
